subject: Recommendation from Ivan Vulic to improve data curation process
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I met your old colleague Ivan Vulíc who recommended I reach out because of the challenges your team has had around data curation, impacting the advancements in text to speech and automated to speech recognition systems.

I've recently been working with a couple Conversational AI teams (Soundhound, Hume.AI, Abridge etc.) who struggled to scale their text/audio curation & annotation limiting the development and launch of a production-ready voice-assistance building platform. Our tools helped to streamline data pipelines for teams looking to fine-tune & optimise model training.

Would be keen to trade notes and get your thoughts on what we're building - open to a 30-minute chat this or next week?

subject: Catch up at Embedded Vision Summit?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your model training at Prime and noticed you're in
SF for the Embedded Vision Summit, so thought it'd be a great time to
connect.

Quick context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (recently raised a
$30M Series B), working with teams like Flawless, Comcast, and Figure AI.
Our platform brings together data curation, annotation, workflow
orchestration, and model evaluation-helping teams scale faster as their
models and datasets grow in complexity, especially in robotics and
video-heavy pipelines.

Would you be open to a coffee with myself and our US Director, [SENDER], during
the Summit? We'll be around all three days. Happy to set something up
virtually if that's easier.

subject: [Encord] AI Execs Dinner @ Quince (3* Michelin) 06/05
text:
Hey [NAME],

Hope all is well. Our co-founder, [SENDER] & [SENDER], are hosting an exclusive AI
roundtable dinner at the 3-star Michelin restaurant Quince in SF on June
5th with ChenLi Wang (General Partner @ WndrCo) moderating the discussion
and they'd love for you to join!

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're an AI scale-up ($50M
Next47/CRV/YC) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, workflow
management and model evaluation under one platform - we work with a couple
of your portfolio companies like Slamcore & Pickle Robot, as well as Woven
by Toyota.

It'll be an intimate event with CxOs, founders, and VPs from orgs like
Netflix, Dolby, Serve Robotics, Adobe, GSK, Zipline, including senior
leaders from several cutting-edge AI team behind Llama, GPT and others -
capping the attendance at around 12 people to ensure an engaging,
off-the-record discussion.

The dinner will run from 6:30-9:30pm and the focus will be on scaling AI
from theory to impact. We'll dive into questions around translating AI
models into actionable solutions, balancing cutting-edge advancements with
practical results, and identifying the most promising opportunities in the
AI space today.

The evening will be a great chance to network with like minded leaders in
the space so let me know if you're available to join and I can send over an
invite.
